title: First Contact — flight polish
body:
The carriers send out larger fighters before the main batteries open. Close overhead views show craft leaving the actual bays, inheriting carrier velocity and curving into their departure lanes. The story continues through fighter interception, capital volleys, flank orders, reserve commitment and a covered withdrawal. Two views from above the turrets show real traverse and paid weapon fire.

The native movement core now carries acceleration, maneuver and turn history rather than replacing velocity with an avoidance impulse. Fighters commit to passes and turns, while larger ships approach and brake with more inertia. Formation layouts keep a stable center through launches and casualties. Rendering, visibility and camera observation share the same interpolated committed poses.

Guided rounds use a shared 668-triangle missile model when their projected size warrants it, with cheap distant markers and bounded exhaust. Optional thruster halos use batched quads. The original starry sky remains selectable alongside a sparse void and a dark background. Every ship still owns its ammunition, heat, shields and damage.

This 4:17 development film uses edited playback speed, an independent authored camera and a procedural guide score. The project includes an updated storyboard and a single timed music-generation prompt for the orchestral replacement. Both earlier movies and their reproduction inputs remain preserved. The full 1080p60 copy and master are retained locally; this candidate is HD at 60 fps.

images.alt: Larger fleet craft and blue shield surfaces in the revised First Contact film.

videos.caption: First Contact — Flight Polish: 4:17 of smooth native flight, overhead carrier deployment, turret views, physical missiles and coordinated fleet combat. Procedural guide score; orchestral generation prompt retained separately.
